title: Adiabatic Expansions for Gapless Quantum Systems
exact_target: Determine whether the source adiabatic-expansion method extends to gapless quantum systems, including noninteracting ones.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005662 (OWR-14297742-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Many-Body Quantum Systems (2023), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2023/39, pp. 2247--2302. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: An extension must state its observables, time scaling and error estimates; the question does not assume an adiabatic theorem with the same hypotheses as in the gapped case.
